sourceRevision: ff84b1cc + the canonical V1 registration working tree, including the final double-withdraw step-02 terminal-prefix conformance fix (identities and indexed surfaces re-derived through an isolated scratch index; blueprint built with aiken v1.1.23+2a78108 under env testnet)
reviewNote: This is the single consolidated IG1 + IG2 ABI review required by the B34 acceptance criteria. It is a binding layer, not a re-pinning: F02 owns the 132-row format registry, the HeaderV1 gate owns the three-way HeaderV1 contract, sdk-abi-fixtures owns the 86 golden encodings and F20 owns the coverage reconciliation, and this artifact binds those surfaces by number instead of copying their contents. Everything derived here was re-measured from the canonical V1 registration working tree by demo/scripts/verify-canonical-v1-abi-freeze.mjs through an isolated scratch index; nothing in this file is its own authority. The final prelaunch double-withdraw step-02 Args terminal-prefix correction is included in this recapture: the testnet blueprint byte digest is 78a2d3cc328a60a845cecabe243d92f500893847b3e5dcaf50829dff4cd5b71a, and the dedicated builder reports compiled-code digest b2e814ee8bfc439ac0a458e913f4e2a2ea2af57233787bbbc625e02a837642f5 plus applied step-01 hash 464c8dad1942dea52d6c41879f80bedae5262d2a4fd210049b276c7d and step-02 hash 5d67c14c76e7c5642f4e34664b47f2535af523d756af80d7a7995c87. The correction changes those bytes and hashes without changing the structural identity counts or validator titles. The blueprint carries 480 validators and the validator tree carries 26 fraud-proof directories. The seven deployment/reference identities agree across midgard-core, midgard-node and midgard-sdk at 107 contracts, 25 ordered catalogue categories, 90 reference-script roles and 91 auth-token names; the one token-only extra remains the V1 validation-trace CEK direct resolver. The catalogue is dense through category id 00000018 and covers every actual family directory, with mpf-chunked-proof remaining the sole declared uncategorised shared verifier. ABI-04 still records declarationOrder DIVERGENT because core and SDK list the same 91-role token mapping in different key orders; consumers address the record by key and the gate publishes the divergence rather than treating record order as wire identity. Registration makes source-derived deployment reachability PASS, but it does not prove autonomous watcher integration, valid-block rejection, maximum proof fit, correction, or missing matrix evidence. IG2 therefore remains BLOCKED with 0 integrable families and 25 violations: every registered family lacks at least one required evidence dimension. F20 is deliberately not rewritten here; its binding inventory still records 11 registered categories and 18 validator directories, so both measured drift findings remain published against the frozen 25-category catalogue and 26-directory tree.
